title: The affine opens of a scheme form a basis of its topology (Stacks 01IT)
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For every open subset $W\subseteq X$ and every point $x\in W$ there is an open subset $U\subseteq X$ with $x\in U\subseteq W$ such that the open subscheme $(U,\mathcal O_X|_U)$ is affine, i.e. isomorphic to $\operatorname{Spec}A$ for a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Equivalently, the affine opens of $X$ form a basis of the topology of $X$.
